## Progress

- Merged [PR #31](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/31): audit.AuditEvents is an append-only SQL ledger table with tenant RLS; `.Audited()` endpoint filter writes one event per request and fails closed; ledger digest verification test; mutation-checked
- Merged [PR #50](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/50): endpoint enumeration test: every signed-in endpoint is `.Audited(...)` or reviewed as free of patient data (fails closed), and each audited endpoint is called on real SQL Server and must write exactly one audit row; mutation-checked
- Fix PR (branch fix/MDV-P0-017-audit-outcome-ratelimit): one outcome rule in the `.Audited()` filter, which now writes after the endpoint answers and before the answer is sent (401/403 → Denied, 404 → new NotFound, else Allowed); Scheduling maps its errors inside the filter, so a refused scheduling call is no longer audited as Allowed; clinic queries no longer refetch audited reads on tab focus or retry 4xx; mutation-checked
- Left: daily digest export to immutable Blob (needs Azure, MDV-P0-006); audit row in the use case's own transaction for writes (shortcut in AuditedEndpoint)

## Description

AUDIT_EVENT as an append-only ledger table: actor, tenant, facility, patient ref (opaque id), action, resource ref, purpose, outcome (allowed/denied), timestamp, IP, correlation id — no PHI values. A mediator behaviour and endpoint filter write an event for every read and write of patient data, sign-in, export and permission change. Ledger digests are exported daily to immutable Blob and verified by a scheduled job.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Every endpoint tagged as patient-data read or write produces exactly one audit event per request (test enumerates endpoints).
- [ ] **AC2.** The app identity cannot UPDATE or DELETE audit rows (permission test); ledger verification detects a tampered row in a test database.
- [ ] **AC3.** Audit events contain opaque patient ids only; a test scans payloads for names, phone numbers and identifiers and fails if found.
- [ ] **AC4.** Daily digest export to an immutable (time-based retention) container succeeds and verification runs on schedule with an alert on mismatch.
- [ ] **AC5.** Denied authorization attempts are audited with outcome "denied".

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
